Fusion-Fuzz Bugs

Bugs found by Fusion-Fuzz in compilers and language runtimes, newest first. Each entry has its reproducer and output; reported bugs link to the upstream report.

github.com/fusion-fuzz/fusion-fuzz

Note. We do not report most bugs from Dec. 2026 due to the growing bug flooding problem, and we show found bugs in this tracker. Many bugs found by Fusion-Fuzz have not been reported yet (marked Unreported). It is known that they are mixed with false alarms and duplicate bugs. We appreciate any effort to filter, validate, report, and fix true and important bugs to the corresponding vendors for more robust programming language implementations. Fusion-Fuzz.
